world_org_meetings.title: Carney to push for closer ties at Canada-EU summit in Montreal
world_org_meetings.description: The term "associate member" is reportedly off the table as officials discuss deeper economic and defence ties.

world_org_meetings.title: EU dropping associate membership title for its closer alliance with Canada
world_org_meetings.description: The words "associate membership" were removed from a joint statement expected to be released at this week's Canada-EU summit, according to a draft seen by CBC News.

world_org_meetings.title: Most nations at UN vote to condemn U.S. embargo on Cuba
world_org_meetings.description: The United Nations General Assembly overwhelmingly urged an ‌end to the decades-long U.S. economic embargo on Cuba on Wednesday, but a U.S. lobbying push led several countries to oppose the resolution or abstain for the first time in years.

world_org_meetings.title: Canada-EU summit: What do both sides want, and what’s at stake?
world_org_meetings.description: The EU has proposed to make Canada its first associate member amid tensions over US tariffs.

world_org_meetings.title: U.S. and Cuban officials get into shouting match on floor of United Nations
world_org_meetings.description: U.S. and Cuban officials engaged in a stunning shouting match on the floor of the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday, the latest in a series of public spats between the longtime adversaries over Washington's escalating economic campaign against Havana.

diplomatic_visits.title: Carney hosts EU leaders as Trump pushes Canada toward Europe, but membership label faces resistance
diplomatic_visits.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has called Canada “the most European of non-European countries” early in President Donald Trump’s trade war

diplomatic_visits.title: Canada and EU drop associate membership plan in bid to deepen ties
diplomatic_visits.description: Canada and the European Union will pursue closer ties but have dropped a proposal for associate EU membership, according to a joint declaration ahead of Thursday’s summit in Montreal. Prime Minister Mark Carney is seeking to reduce Canada’s reliance on the US, despite warnings from Donald Trump.

diplomatic_visits.title: Bahamas: King Charles III dances with locals during Caribbean visit
diplomatic_visits.description: King Charles III showed off his dance moves during a colourful Junkanoo street parade in Nassau, the capital of the Bahamas, on Wednesday, 28 October, as part of his first Caribbean tour since becoming monarch.

diplomatic_visits.title: Putin woos African leaders as Moscow seeks to expand footprint in Africa
diplomatic_visits.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin sought to woo African leaders and government delegates on Wednesday as they gathered in Moscow for the third Russia-Africa Summit to discuss trade, security, arms deals and grain supplies as part of the Kremlin's strategic efforts to expand its footprint in Africa.

diplomatic_visits.title: Ethiopia receives 12 Russian Su-35 jets, plans S-400 acquisition
diplomatic_visits.description: PM Abiy Ahmed makes announcement during a Moscow summit as Ethiopia battles armed groups in Tigray and Amhara.

elections.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
elections.description: With 93% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.

elections.title: Spain reckons with 2nd deadly train crash of the year ahead of national election
elections.description: Spain's second high-speed rail disaster this year, a crash in which one train struck another from behind, killing 68 people, has raised fresh concerns about the safety of the country's rail network.

elections.title: Spanish rescue workers search for any survivors in high-speed rail crash, with 69 dead
elections.description: Spain's second high-speed rail disaster this year, in which one train struck another from behind, killing 69 people, has raised fresh concerns about the safety of the country's rail network ahead of a national election.

elections.title: Flavio Bolsonaro lands in US, declares himself 'leader' of Brazil
elections.description: Flavio Bolsonaro declared himself the rightful leader of his country despite losing the presidential election runoff on Sunday. He and his family have fled to the US.

elections.title: From election defeat to Miami: What to know about Brazil's Bolsonaro's dramatic departure to the US
elections.description: Flávio Bolsonaro fled to Miami with his family after his defeat by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Brazil’s presidential election. The 45-year-old ally of US President Donald Trump arrived in Florida on Wednesday, despite Brazil’s Supreme Court reportedly deeming him a flight risk amid ongoing corruption investigations and ordering his passports seized. FRANCE 24 International Affairs Editor Philip Turle explains what you need to know about the election and Bolsonaro’s departure.
